rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an animal or plant species, or a group, with no living members.

example.english: This species of sea turtle is now extinct.
example.traditional: 呢種海龜而家已經絕種喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hoi2 gwai1 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 zyut6 zung2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a family or lineage that has no descendants left, rather than for an extinct species.

example.english: This branch of the family has long been extinct.
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 fong2 zou2 zau6 zyut6 hau6 laa3
